newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stock exchange closed on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stock exchange closed on Friday.

text.p: Singapore shares were untraded on Friday as the Stock Exchange of Singapore closed for the Lunar New Year public holiday.
The exchange traded only half a day on Thursday with the key Straits Times Industrials Index ending up 7.61 points at 2,203.39.
Volume was a reasonable 151.5 million shares showing 221 gainers against 81 losers, with Malaysian over-the-counter stocks the most active, led by MBF Holdings.
Asia Pacific Breweries topped gainers, up 45 cents to Singapore $8.30, but with low volume.
Shares in Creative Technology see-sawed again to end as the biggest loser down 40 cents at S$19.20. Creative's shares have alternately been the market's biggest gainer and loser each day this week.
Trading in Singapore shares resumes on Tuesday at 0100 GMT.
